Waiting for the left shoulder key: an 8-second capture starts automatically after preflight. Afterwards re-select the OEM rapid fire in GameSpace, hold the left key for about 3 seconds, release it, then come back to check. The test value is fixed at 20/s; the real loop speed and release-stop must both be observed.
Left key passed. Capture and verify the right shoulder key the same way; the three-layer codes of the two sides may differ.
Both sides reached the native layer; confirming system_server stays stable. About %1$d seconds left.
The device or module version changed; the old compatibility token expired and a new test is required.

Compatibility test failed; the feature stays locked and the OEM shoulder keys are unaffected.
This test exceeded 10 minutes; targets were reset. Please start over.
Shoulder keys temporarily woken. Touch and release only the %1$s shoulder key (about %2$d seconds left); the original state is restored automatically afterwards.
